title: Gua Sha Self-Care Workshop in San Diego
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Unlock the secrets of radiant skin at a Gua Sha Self-Care Workshop in San Diego, led by skincare expert Lini. This intimate session invites you to learn essential techniques to release jaw tension, sculpt cheekbones, and integrate ancient beauty rituals into your daily life. Participants will discover the art of using Gua Sha tools, including the perfect oil application and pressure for glowing results. Enjoy hands-on guidance, complimentary refreshments, and the opportunity to purchase exclusive skincare products post-workshop for continued self-care at home.
